title: Ashlar-Vellum Cobalt XE File Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-121744)
description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Ashlar-Vellum Cobalt XE file parsing. This flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code if a user opens a crafted malicious file or visits a malicious page. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user-supplied data length before copying to a stack buffer.
